name: verify_patient
description: Verify the person is the patient by full name and date of birth. Every patient-specific tool needs this first in the conversation; a failed match discloses nothing.

name: find_available_slots
description: Open slots computed from the providers' calendars and clinic sessions: every session slot minus calendar events (bookings, blocks) and other patients' live holds, within the notice and horizon limits. Give a specialty or a provider.

patient_id.description: The verified patient, so their own hold counts as free

name: book_appointment
description: Book the verified patient into a slot after they confirmed provider, date, time and location. Writes the clinic appointment and the provider's calendar event together. Referral specialties need an active referral; the provider must accept the patient's insurer unless the patient agreed to self-pay.

reason.description: Reason for the visit, in the patient's words

confirmed.description: True once the patient said yes to the read-back

self_pay.description: True only when the patient agreed to pay themselves

request_key.description: Idempotency key; reuse it when retrying

name: list_appointments
description: The verified patient's appointments, past and future, with status.

name: get_appointment
description: One appointment of the verified patient, with provider and location.

name: reschedule_appointment
description: Move the verified patient's appointment to a new slot of the same specialty after they confirmed. The replacement is committed before the original time is released; if it cannot be committed the original stays. Not within the change-notice window.

confirmed.description: True once the patient said yes

name: cancel_appointment
description: Cancel the verified patient's appointment after they confirmed which one. Not within the change-notice window (late cancellations go to the front desk).

name: update_insurance
description: Record the verified patient's insurer and member number after reading them back. It records cover details; it never says whether a visit is covered.

group_number.description: Group or scheme number, if any

confirmed.description: True once the patient confirmed the read-back

name: send_intake_forms
description: Send the intake forms for the patient's visit by email or SMS to the contact on file.

appointment_id.description: The visit the forms are for

name: escalate_to_staff
description: Hand the case to staff: nurse_line for symptoms that may be urgent (with urgency urgent), front_desk for late changes, proxy access and anything the desk cannot do, referrals_team for referral paperwork.

name: get_provider_directory
description: Providers with specialty, languages, insurers accepted, whether a referral is needed, their calendar and their weekly sessions by location.

name: get_referral_status
description: The verified patient's referrals: specialty, status, referring practice, expiry, and whether each can be used for booking now.

name: create_referral_request
description: Open a referral request for a specialty that needs one; the referrals team asks the patient's practice. Booking stays closed until the referral is active.

referring_practice.description: The patient's practice, if they said

name: hold_slot
description: Hold a free slot for the verified patient for a few minutes while they decide; one live hold per patient.

name: release_hold
description: Release a live hold the verified patient no longer wants.

name: get_location_info
description: Clinic locations: address, phone, opening hours, parking and accessibility.

location_id.description: LOC-CEN, LOC-NOR or LOC-WES; all when omitted

name: get_preparation_instructions
description: What a patient should do and bring before a visit of a specialty, and its intake forms.

name: add_to_waitlist
description: Put the verified patient on the waitlist for an earlier slot of a specialty (optionally one provider) between two dates; one active entry per specialty.

name: list_calendars
description: The calendars the user has access to, with their IDs; resolves a calendar name to its calendar_id. accessRole says what the user may do on each.

pageSize.description: Max results per page. Default 100, max 250.

name: list_events
description: Events on a calendar matching the constraints. Set startTime and endTime only when a specific timeframe is requested. For open-ended keyword searches on the primary calendar use search_events.

calendarId.description: Calendar ID from list_calendars. Default: the primary calendar.

pageSize.description: Max events per page (default 100, max 250). Recommended: 10.

startTime.description: Start of the timeframe (ISO 8601, for example '2026-04-30T10:00:00Z').

endTime.description: End of the timeframe (ISO 8601, for example '2026-04-30T10:00:00Z').

timeZone.description: IANA Time Zone Database name (for example America/Los_Angeles).

fullText.description: Free-form search over title, description, location and attendees (all terms must match).

name: get_event
description: A single event on a calendar.

calendarId.description: Calendar ID from list_calendars. Default: the primary calendar.

name: search_events
description: Searches events on the user's primary calendar by keywords (case-insensitive).

query.description: Query string to search for events.

name: suggest_time
description: Suggests free time slots across the attendees' calendars within a query interval, respecting the configured buffer between events. A suggestion reserves nothing: create the event after the user confirms.

attendeeEmails.description: Attendee emails to find free time for.

timeZone.description: IANA Time Zone Database name (for example America/Los_Angeles).

name: create_event
description: Creates an event on a calendar. Attendees must be reachable within the attendee domain policy; conflicts with confirmed events are refused. Needs the user's approval of this exact event (approval_id).

calendarId.description: Calendar ID from list_calendars. Default: the primary calendar.

timeZone.description: IANA Time Zone Database name (for example America/Los_Angeles).

approval_id.description: The approval authorizing this change; required while the environment requires approval for mutations.

name: update_event
description: Updates an event; fields that are not set are not changed. Moving only the start preserves the duration. Needs approval_id, and expected_version must match the event's current version.

eventId.description: The ID of the event to update.

calendarId.description: Calendar ID from list_calendars. Default: the primary calendar.

timeZone.description: IANA Time Zone Database name (for example America/Los_Angeles).

approval_id.description: The approval authorizing this change; required while the environment requires approval for mutations.

expected_version.description: The event version the change was decided on; a stale version is refused.

name: delete_event
description: Cancels an event. For a recurring event, recurring_action says whether this occurrence (default) or the whole series is cancelled. Needs approval_id.

eventId.description: The ID of the event to delete.

calendarId.description: Calendar ID from list_calendars. Default: the primary calendar.

approval_id.description: The approval authorizing this change; required while the environment requires approval for mutations.

name: search_threads
description: Lists email threads matching a Gmail search query (label:ID, is:unread, in:inbox, from:, to:, subject:, newer_than:7d, free terms). Full message bodies are not returned; use get_thread for them. Drafts, spam and trash are excluded.

name: get_thread
description: Retrieves an email thread by ID with its messages in date order (bodies under FULL_CONTENT).

threadId.description: The unique identifier of the thread.

messageFormat.description: MESSAGE_FORMAT_UNSPECIFIED, MINIMAL, FULL_CONTENT (default; bodies included) or METADATA_ONLY.

name: get_message
description: Retrieves one email message by its message ID.

messageId.description: The unique identifier of the message.

messageFormat.description: MESSAGE_FORMAT_UNSPECIFIED, MINIMAL, FULL_CONTENT (default; bodies included) or METADATA_ONLY.

name: list_labels
description: Lists the user-defined labels of the mailbox with their IDs. System label IDs (INBOX, UNREAD, STARRED, IMPORTANT, SENT, DRAFT, SPAM, TRASH) are usable without listing.

name: label_thread
description: Adds labels to an entire thread (every message in it). Takes label IDs, not names; use list_labels when unsure of a user label's ID.

threadId.description: The unique identifier of the thread.

labelIds.description: Label IDs (system IDs such as INBOX, UNREAD, IMPORTANT, or user label IDs from list_labels), never names.

name: unlabel_thread
description: Removes labels from an entire thread. Takes label IDs, not names.

threadId.description: The unique identifier of the thread.

labelIds.description: Label IDs (system IDs such as INBOX, UNREAD, IMPORTANT, or user label IDs from list_labels), never names.

name: list_drafts
description: Lists the mailbox's drafts, newest first. humanEdited marks a draft a person has edited.

name: create_draft
description: Creates a draft email for a person to review and send. To reply in an existing thread pass the original message's ID as replyToMessageId. Addresses are plain (no 'Name <email>'). Attachments are not supported yet. Nothing is sent.

replyToMessageId.description: The message this draft replies to; the draft joins its thread.
